Summary:
Arunodoy Banerjee is a backend-focused software engineer studying Computer Science (AI & ML) at Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology. Selected work: Zone (an offline Bluetooth store-carry-forward mesh for disaster zones), Cadence (a speaking-first language app), Nura (family nutrition tracking on Android), Meow AI and Nakung AI (Chrome extensions for developers), Your-Reviewer (open-source AI code review), RedZone (disaster relocation decision support) and Vaayu (carbon accounting). The site includes project documentation, open-source direction and contact details.
